comments.author: @sharpaspirant
comments.text: Malta looks absolutely beautiful! I really enjoyed seeing what everyday life is like on such a small Mediterranean island not just the stunning scenery, but also the streets, culture, architecture, and slower pace of life. It’s fascinating to see how people have built such a unique lifestyle around island living. This documentary definitely made Malta jump higher on my travel bucket list! Thanks for sharing such a beautiful journey, Best Travel!
